name: SK Square Co., Ltd.
description: SK Square is an investment holding company spun out of SK Telecom in November 2021. It holds approximately 20.1% of SK Hynix, which comprises over 96% of its net asset value. The company also invests in ICT, AI, semiconductor-adjacent, and blockchain ventures through its Singapore-based entity TGC Square. SK Square historically trades at a 25–47% discount to NAV; management targets a 30% or lower discount by 2028. NH Investment raised its target price to 1.1 million won in April 2026. The company executed 200 billion won in share buybacks in 2024 and 100 billion won in 2025, with 210 billion won planned for 2026.
pfic_notes: Classified by many tax practitioners as a likely PFIC for U.S. investors due to its holding-company structure: income consists primarily of dividends and capital gains from SK Hynix and other passive equity stakes, and assets are predominantly passive equity holdings. U.S. shareholders may be subject to the excess distribution method (highest ordinary income rate + interest charge) and must file IRS Form 8621 annually. QEF election is generally unavailable without company-supplied earnings statements. U.S. investors are typically advised to access SK Hynix exposure through 000660.KS instead.
